status: DESIGN REQUIREMENT AND PRELIMINARY ARCHITECTURE; NOT THERMALLY QUALIFIED

cooling.basis: User explicitly requires passive cooling; do not add a fan as a fallback.

retained_requirements.sustained_vpn_target: approach 1 Gbit/s; not measured or guaranteed

thermal_architecture: Use a metal heat spreader with a compliant electrically insulating TIM on the processor package top.
Conduct heat to a metal enclosure panel with a designed contact path; do not rely only on heat transfer through FR4.
Keep display glass, flex and adhesive outside the primary processor heat-transfer/contact-pressure path.
Provide separate mechanical support for the display and controlled TIM compression; no clamp load on LCD glass or small PCB components.
Keep RF antenna feed and external antenna isolated from heat-spreader short circuits and mechanically clear.

processor_documentation.source_limit: Manufacturer calls thermal data simulation for reference only; test board is 114.3x101.6mm, four layers, 1.6mm at ambient25C. ThetaJA must not be transplanted to this closed enclosure.
processor_documentation.design_note: 125C is an absolute limit, not a sustained operating target or approved firmware trip.

software_requirements: Enable verified RK3568 thermal sensor calibration and active-low external shutdown path through R1507.
Use CPU DVFS and runtime power management; unused GPU/NPU/video blocks should not run workloads.
Establish throttle/shutdown thresholds from all component operating limits and measured case/display temperatures; not from SoC absolute maximum alone.
Measure throughput during thermal steady state; report any throttling as a performance limitation, not a gigabit pass.
No fan controller or fan fallback.
release_conditions: Measure total power under Ethernet forwarding, encrypted tunnel, Wi-Fi plus VPN, full display backlight and any supported expansion load.
Close the actual enclosure and test intended ambient range, orientation, blocked bottom face and prolonged operation.
Verify SoC, PMIC, DDR, PHY, Wi-Fi, MLCC body, display, adhesive and connector temperatures against their respective limits.
Verify case surface temperature using an appropriate product touch-temperature criterion; the current55C screen is not certification.
If passive enclosure and throughput cannot both be met, revise area/fin geometry or power architecture before requesting a requirement tradeoff.
